title: BREAD AND BULLETS
description: The Oppressive tax rate has broken the back of the working class. Riots have erupted in the industrial sector of Aldmark. The mob has seized a munitions depot and is demanding immediate tax relief.

title: ALDMARK MUNITIONS BLAST
description: During the military crackdown, a stray bullet struck a volatile artillery shell casing. The resulting explosion leveled three city blocks and collapsed the underground transit network.

title: THE VOSK SCIENTIST
description: A high-ranking Vosk engineer has defected across the frozen Frontier. He offers blueprints for their Cold-Weather Equipment, but demands 150,000 CR to start a new life in neutral Oakhaven.

choices.label: Pay the man. We need that tech.
Throw him in a black site and extract it.

title: R&D BREAKTHROUGH: WINTER GEAR
description: The defector arrived safely in Oakhaven. True to his word, our agents recovered a dead-drop containing the schematics.

choices.label: Issue it to the men immediately.

title: DEFECTOR FOUND DEAD
description: The Vosk scientist died during our 'enhanced interrogation'. The blueprints were in his head, and now they are gone forever.

title: PROJECT CHIMERA
description: A highly classified military biolab has suffered a containment breach during a Vosk air raid. The researchers are dead, and a weaponized pathogen is spreading into the city.

choices.label: [COVER UP] Deny everything to avoid mass panic.

title: THE DUKE'S CUT
description: Internal Security has uncovered a massive discrepancy in the war budget. Duke Vargus has been secretly siphoning treasury funds into offshore accounts. Confronted, he claims it is a 'necessary administrative fee' for his genius.

choices.label: [IGNORE IT] We need his financial mind to survive.

title: THE LOYALISTS STRIKE
description: Duke Vargus is dead, but his loyalists in the bureaucracy have retaliated. They have deliberately destroyed a major dam, flooding our supply routes.

title: THE HEIR'S AMBITION
description: Your son, Julian, is tired of safely observing the war from High Command. He is publicly demanding to be assigned as the frontline commander of a vanguard division.

choices.label: [DENY HIM] He stays in the capital where it is safe.

title: THE HEIR IS SURROUNDED
description: Julian's inexperience has cost us dearly. He pushed his division too far ahead of their supply lines. They are now surrounded by Vosk armor. If we do not send immediate relief, the Heir will die.

choices.label: [DIVERT RESERVES] Save him at all costs!
[ABANDON HIM] We cannot risk the front for one boy.

title: A NATION MOURNS
description: The division was annihilated. Julian's body was recovered from the snow. Your wife, Lady Elara, is inconsolable. The line of succession is shattered.

choices.label: We will make the Vosk pay.
